While dGSLM is full-duplex, it remains a proof-of-concept: it does not run in an online fashion, it does not benefit from the knowledge of a text language model, and it does not model acoustic information as it only models semantic tokens. Moshi addresses these limitations altogether: by modeling two streams of semantic and acoustic tokens hierarchically, Moshi is full duplex and can exploit all the information from the user (linguistic and non-linguistic) while producing speech in real time.
